title: Jingyu scene description v1
description: A declarative scene: generator calls for geometry and materials, plus lights, cameras and render settings. Lengths in metres, angles in degrees, Z up, colours as sRGB hex. Objects stand on their origin.

intent.description: One sentence: what the picture must make a viewer see or feel. Reviews judge the render against it; never affects rendering.

accept_warnings.description: Warning codes that describe the picture as intended, e.g. frame.underexposed for a deliberately dark image; they are no longer reported. Prefer fixing the scene.

world.description: The light around the scene. Without environment it is a uniform color at strength; with one, the environment family decides and color and strength are ignored.

op.description: Which geometry operator to use.

then.title: box
then.description: Axis-aligned box standing on its origin, its edges optionally rounded.

op.description: Axis-aligned box standing on its origin, its edges optionally rounded.

size.description: Width (x), depth (y) and height (z) in metres.

bevel.description: Radius of the rounded edges in metres; a few millimetres catch the light like a real, handled object. 0 is razor-sharp.

then.title: plane
then.description: Flat rectangle in the XY plane, centred on its origin, facing +Z.

op.description: Flat rectangle in the XY plane, centred on its origin, facing +Z.

then.title: sphere
then.description: UV sphere resting on its origin (its lowest point).

op.description: UV sphere resting on its origin (its lowest point).

segments.description: Number of segments around the axis; more is smoother and heavier.

rings.description: Number of rings from pole to pole.

then.title: cylinder
then.description: Closed cylinder standing on its origin.

op.description: Closed cylinder standing on its origin.

segments.description: Number of segments around the axis; more is smoother and heavier.

then.title: cone
then.description: Cone or truncated cone standing on its origin.

op.description: Cone or truncated cone standing on its origin.

top_radius.description: Top radius in metres; 0 makes a point.

segments.description: Number of segments around the axis; more is smoother and heavier.

then.title: lathe
then.description: Revolve an (r, z) profile around the Z axis. thickness 0 makes a solid; thickness > 0 makes an open-topped shell with a closed floor.

op.description: Revolve an (r, z) profile around the Z axis. thickness 0 makes a solid; thickness > 0 makes an open-topped shell with a closed floor.

profile.description: Points [r, z] in metres from the bottom outer edge upward. r >= 0. A solid is closed to the axis automatically at both ends.

thickness.description: Wall thickness in metres; 0 for a solid.

segments.description: Number of segments around the axis; more is smoother and heavier.

sharp_angle.description: Profile corners turning more than this many degrees are shaded crisply.

then.title: vessel
then.description: Parametric vessel family (cup, bowl, vase, bottle, jar, pot): a lathe whose outer wall passes smoothly through base, belly, neck and lip rings.

op.description: Parametric vessel family (cup, bowl, vase, bottle, jar, pot): a lathe whose outer wall passes smoothly through base, belly, neck and lip rings.

belly_at.description: Height of the belly as a fraction of the height.

neck_at.description: Height of the neck as a fraction of the height.

thickness.description: Wall and floor thickness in metres (open vessels only).

open.description: true: hollow with an open top; false: a closed solid.

segments.description: Number of segments around the axis.

profile_samples.description: Number of points sampled along the wall.

sharp_angle.description: Profile corners turning more than this many degrees are shaded crisply.

wobble.description: Hand-made irregularity: 0 machine-perfect, 0.3 thrown on a wheel (slightly out of round, gently leaning), 1 rustic.

seed.description: Variation of the irregularity: another number, another pot.

then.title: extrude
then.description: A floor plan pulled straight up: any simple polygon (an L-shaped counter, a hexagonal tile, a slab of irregular stone), optionally narrowing to the top.

op.description: A floor plan pulled straight up: any simple polygon (an L-shaped counter, a hexagonal tile, a slab of irregular stone), optionally narrowing to the top.

profile.description: Corners [x, y] of the outline in metres, in order around it; kept where they are (not centred).

taper.description: Scale of the top outline about its centre: 1 straight walls, 0.5 half-size top.

then.title: sweep
then.description: A round tube along a smooth path through points: a mug handle, a pipe, a cable, a stem, a bent rod; it may narrow from one end to the other. The path is kept where it is written.

op.description: A round tube along a smooth path through points: a mug handle, a pipe, a cable, a stem, a bent rod; it may narrow from one end to the other. The path is kept where it is written.

path.description: Points [x, y, z] in metres the tube passes through, in order; the curve between them is smooth.

radius.description: Radius at the start in metres.

radius_end.description: Radius at the end in metres; 0 keeps the start radius.

samples.description: Smooth steps between neighbouring path points.

then.title: scatter
then.description: Copies of one shape strewn over a rectangle or disc on the ground, each turned, sized and tilted a little differently: pebbles, fallen leaves, a pile of beads, tufts. One object, one material.

op.description: Copies of one shape strewn over a rectangle or disc on the ground, each turned, sized and tilted a little differently: pebbles, fallen leaves, a pile of beads, tufts. One object, one material.

item.description: The shape to copy: any geometry call, e.g. a small sphere.

area.description: Width (x) and depth (y) of the area in metres.

shape.description: The area is a rectangle, or the disc (ellipse) inside it.

spacing.description: Least distance between copies' centres in metres; fewer than count fit when it is large.

scale_jitter.description: How much the size varies: 0 all alike, 0.3 up to 30 % larger or smaller.

tilt.description: Largest lean of a copy in degrees.

seed.description: Another number, another arrangement.

then.title: wall
then.description: Upright slab standing on its origin, spanning x, with rectangular openings cut through it (windows, doors), optionally framed and glazed. Light passes through the openings. For a whole room use room.

op.description: Upright slab standing on its origin, spanning x, with rectangular openings cut through it (windows, doors), optionally framed and glazed. Light passes through the openings. For a whole room use room.

size.description: Width (x), thickness (y) and height (z) in metres.

x.description: Centre of the opening along the wall from the wall's middle, metres.

sill.description: Height of the opening's bottom edge above the floor; 0 = door.

frame.description: Width of the frame around the opening in metres (part frames); 0 leaves a bare hole.

glass.description: true fills the opening with a pane (part glass, clear glass unless part_materials says otherwise).

openings.description: Rectangular holes through the wall; x is measured from its centre.

then.title: room
then.description: A closed room: four walls with doors and windows, a floor and a ceiling, in one call. Its origin is the middle of the floor surface; things stand on it with rest_on. Openings are named by wall, so no wall has to be turned or placed by hand.

op.description: A closed room: four walls with doors and windows, a floor and a ceiling, in one call. Its origin is the middle of the floor surface; things stand on it with rest_on. Openings are named by wall, so no wall has to be turned or placed by hand.

size.description: Inside width (x), depth (y) and height (z) in metres.

wall_thickness.description: Thickness of the walls in metres; windows get deep reveals in thick walls.

slab_thickness.description: Thickness of the floor and ceiling slabs in metres.

ceiling.description: Include the ceiling; without it the sky pours in from above.

x.description: Centre of the opening along the wall from the wall's middle, metres, positive to the right seen from inside the room.

sill.description: Height of the opening's bottom edge above the floor; 0 = door.

frame.description: Width of the frame around the opening in metres (part frames); 0 leaves a bare hole.

glass.description: true fills the opening with a pane (part glass, clear glass unless part_materials says otherwise).

wall.description: Which wall: back (+y), front (-y), left (-x) or right (+x), in the room's own axes.

openings.description: Doors and windows; each names its wall.

then.title: table
then.description: A table: a top on four legs, with an optional apron. size is the overall width, depth and height (the top surface).

op.description: A table: a top on four legs, with an optional apron. size is the overall width, depth and height (the top surface).

size.description: Overall width (x), depth (y) and height (z) in metres.

top_thickness.description: Thickness of the top in metres.

leg_thickness.description: Width of a leg in metres.

leg_inset.description: Distance from the top's edge to the legs in metres.

legs.description: Leg shape: square posts, round posts or round and tapering.

apron.description: Height of the rail under the top in metres; 0 for none.

bevel.description: Radius of rounded edges in metres; a few millimetres catch the light like a real, handled object. 0 is razor-sharp.

then.title: chair
then.description: A dining chair: four legs, a seat, and a back of slats or a panel. It faces -y; its back is on the +y side. Turn it with rotation.

op.description: A dining chair: four legs, a seat, and a back of slats or a panel. It faces -y; its back is on the +y side. Turn it with rotation.

seat_height.description: Height of the seat's top in metres.

seat_size.description: Seat width (x) and depth (y) in metres.

back_height.description: Height of the back above the seat in metres; 0 makes a stool.

back.description: Vertical slats, a solid panel, or only the top rail and posts.

slats.description: Number of slats in a slatted back.

leg_thickness.description: Width of a leg in metres.

bevel.description: Radius of rounded edges in metres; a few millimetres catch the light like a real, handled object. 0 is razor-sharp.

then.title: shelf
then.description: A bookcase or open shelf: two sides, top and bottom, evenly spaced shelf boards and a back panel. Its open front faces -y. Put things on a board with rest_on: they fall from where they are onto the board below.

op.description: A bookcase or open shelf: two sides, top and bottom, evenly spaced shelf boards and a back panel. Its open front faces -y. Put things on a board with rest_on: they fall from where they are onto the board below.

size.description: Overall width (x), depth (y) and height (z) in metres.

shelves.description: Number of shelf boards between bottom and top.

plinth.description: Height of the recessed base under the bottom board in metres; 0 for none.

bevel.description: Radius of rounded edges in metres; a few millimetres catch the light like a real, handled object. 0 is razor-sharp.

then.title: terrain
then.description: A piece of land: rolling hills to ridged mountains, as a solid slab standing on its origin. Things stand on it with rest_on; water is a plane at the right height.

op.description: A piece of land: rolling hills to ridged mountains, as a solid slab standing on its origin. Things stand on it with rest_on; water is a plane at the right height.

relief.description: Height from the lowest dip to the highest top, metres.

feature_size.description: Typical width of a hill or valley in metres.

detail.description: Layers of finer bumps on the big shapes.

ridges.description: 0 rounded hills, 1 sharp crests and ravines.

edge_falloff.description: Lower the land toward the edges over this share of its half-size (an island, a patch that blends into a flat floor); 0 keeps the edges as they are.

base.description: Solid ground under the lowest dip, metres.

resolution.description: Grid cells along the longer side; more is finer and heavier.

seed.description: Another number, another one of the same kind.

then.title: rock
then.description: A stone or boulder: a lumpy, irregular solid, flat where it sits on the ground. Every seed is another rock; pebbles are small rocks, scattered.

op.description: A stone or boulder: a lumpy, irregular solid, flat where it sits on the ground. Every seed is another rock; pebbles are small rocks, scattered.

size.description: Rough width (x), depth (y) and height (z) in metres.

roughness.description: 0 a smooth river pebble, 1 a jagged broken block.

feature_size.description: Size of the lumps relative to the rock: small is craggy, large is gently wavy.

sink.description: How much of its height is sunk into the ground (cut flat): 0 resting on its lowest point, 0.3 settled in.

seed.description: Another number, another one of the same kind.

then.title: tree
then.description: A tree: a leaning trunk with branches under a crown of leafy clumps (broadleaf), or a tapering spire of needle tiers (conifer). Seen from a distance; parts trunk and foliage have bark and leaf materials of their own.

op.description: A tree: a leaning trunk with branches under a crown of leafy clumps (broadleaf), or a tapering spire of needle tiers (conifer). Seen from a distance; parts trunk and foliage have bark and leaf materials of their own.

trunk_radius.description: Radius of the trunk at the ground, metres.

crown_radius.description: Radius of the crown in metres; 0 is 30 % of the height.

crown_start.description: Where the crown begins, as a share of the height.

lean.description: Lean of the trunk in degrees.

then.title: grass
then.description: A patch of grass: thousands of thin blades of varied height, bending a little, optionally in clumps. Give it a green, matte material; rest it on the ground.

op.description: A patch of grass: thousands of thin blades of varied height, bending a little, optionally in clumps. Give it a green, matte material; rest it on the ground.

size.description: Width (x) and depth (y) of the patch in metres.

bend.description: How far blades lean over, as a share of their height.

patchiness.description: 0 an even lawn, 1 separate clumps with bare ground between.

color.description: Body or glaze colour. sRGB hex #rrggbb.

gloss.description: Glaze gloss from matte (0) to mirror-like (1).

texture.description: Grain and mottling of the clay body, 0 smooth to 1 coarse; strongest on unglazed (low gloss) pieces.

seed.description: Variation: another number gives another pattern of the same kind.

weathering.description: Time on the surface, for any material; every effect follows the object's shape. 0 is factory-new. A little (0.1-0.3) is what makes a render read as a photograph.

wear.description: Rubbed convex edges and corners: paint and glaze worn thin, gloss dulled.

group.description: An invisible transform that objects, lights, cameras and other groups can belong to (parent); moving the group moves everything in it.

parent.description: Id of a group or an object this entry belongs to. Its location, rotation and aim are then relative to that parent, and it moves with it: fruit parented to its bowl follows the bowl wherever it goes.

accept_warnings.description: Warning codes that are intended for every object in this group, at any depth, e.g. frame.not_visible for the hidden legs and underside of a table.

location.description: Position of the group's origin in metres.

scale.description: Uniform scale factor applied to everything in the group.

material.description: Id of an entry in materials; omitted means neutral grey.

part_materials.description: Materials for the named parts of an assembled geometry (list_generators shows the parts of each op), e.g. {"top": "oak", "base": "steel"}. Parts not named wear material, or their own default (window panes are clear glass).

parent.description: Id of a group or an object this entry belongs to. Its location, rotation and aim are then relative to that parent, and it moves with it: fruit parented to its bowl follows the bowl wherever it goes.

accept_warnings.description: Warning codes that are intended for this object only, e.g. frame.not_visible for a wall or ceiling that closes the room out of sight.

attached_to.description: Ids of objects this one is fixed to on purpose: walls meeting at a corner, a lamp hanging from a ceiling, a nail in a wall. Sinking into them and hovering are then not reported.

rest_on.description: Id of an object to rest on. The object keeps its x and y and falls from where it is onto the nearest surface of that object below it: a shelf board, the floor of a room, the inside of a bowl. Placed below all of them (at height 0, say), it lands on the topmost: a table top.

location.description: Position of the object's origin in metres.

visible.description: false keeps the object in the scene but out of the render.

camera_visible.description: false: the camera does not see the object, but it still reflects, blocks and bounces light. A reflector card (a white matte plane facing the shadow side) or a flag that shades a spot; it may even stand inside the frame. Such objects may hover.

kind.description: A bulb: light from a small sphere in every direction.

temperature_k.description: Colour temperature in kelvin (e.g. 1900 candle, 2700 warm bulb, 5500 noon sun, 7000 overcast); when given it replaces color.

parent.description: Id of a group or an object this entry belongs to. Its location, rotation and aim are then relative to that parent, and it moves with it: fruit parented to its bowl follows the bowl wherever it goes.

radius.description: Size of the emitting sphere in metres; larger is softer.

kind.description: A cone of light, like a stage or track light.

temperature_k.description: Colour temperature in kelvin (e.g. 1900 candle, 2700 warm bulb, 5500 noon sun, 7000 overcast); when given it replaces color.

parent.description: Id of a group or an object this entry belongs to. Its location, rotation and aim are then relative to that parent, and it moves with it: fruit parented to its bowl follows the bowl wherever it goes.

radius.description: Size of the emitting sphere in metres; larger is softer.

blend.description: Edge softness of the cone, 0 to 1.

look_at.description: Point in metres to aim at; the up direction stays +Z.

kind.description: A panel of light; the bigger it is, the softer its shadows (a softbox).

temperature_k.description: Colour temperature in kelvin (e.g. 1900 candle, 2700 warm bulb, 5500 noon sun, 7000 overcast); when given it replaces color.

parent.description: Id of a group or an object this entry belongs to. Its location, rotation and aim are then relative to that parent, and it moves with it: fruit parented to its bowl follows the bowl wherever it goes.

size.description: Width of the emitter in metres (and its depth unless size_y is given).

size_y.description: Depth of a rectangular emitter in metres, e.g. a window-shaped soft light; omitted means square.

look_at.description: Point in metres to aim at; the up direction stays +Z.

kind.description: A helper light that lifts the shadow side: a soft panel that casts no shadow of its own, adds no highlight to glossy things and is never seen by the camera. Use it where real bounce light is missing (a white wall out of frame, a reflector); it is not a second sun.

temperature_k.description: Colour temperature in kelvin (e.g. 1900 candle, 2700 warm bulb, 5500 noon sun, 7000 overcast); when given it replaces color.

parent.description: Id of a group or an object this entry belongs to. Its location, rotation and aim are then relative to that parent, and it moves with it: fruit parented to its bowl follows the bowl wherever it goes.

power_w.description: Emitted power in watts; keep the shadow side darker than the lit side (a fill a few times weaker than the key).

size.description: Width of the panel in metres; bigger is softer.

size_y.description: Depth of a rectangular panel in metres; omitted means square.

look_at.description: Point in metres to aim at; the up direction stays +Z.

kind.description: Parallel light from far away. With a daylight environment use its sun instead.

temperature_k.description: Colour temperature in kelvin (e.g. 1900 candle, 2700 warm bulb, 5500 noon sun, 7000 overcast); when given it replaces color.

parent.description: Id of a group or an object this entry belongs to. Its location, rotation and aim are then relative to that parent, and it moves with it: fruit parented to its bowl follows the bowl wherever it goes.

angle.description: Apparent angular diameter in degrees; larger is softer.

look_at.description: Point in metres to aim at; the up direction stays +Z.

parent.description: Id of a group or an object this entry belongs to. Its location, rotation and aim are then relative to that parent, and it moves with it: fruit parented to its bowl follows the bowl wherever it goes.

look_at.description: Point in metres to aim at; the up direction stays +Z.

shift.description: Lens shift [x, y] as a fraction of the frame; keeps verticals straight.

camera.description: Id of the camera to render through.

resolution.description: Image width and height in pixels.

engine.description: cycles: path traced; eevee: real-time (needs a GPU); workbench: preview shading.

device.description: Cycles device; auto uses a GPU when one is usable.

seed.description: Sampling seed; fixed for reproducibility.

view_transform.description: Tone mapping from scene light to display.

transparent_background.description: Render the world background as transparent.

style.description: Paint the render in a style after it is rendered; the photographic render is kept beside it (view render). Lines follow the scene's real edges.

preset.description: none: The render as it is.; ink: Pen lines along every edge over quiet, flattened colour on paper.; watercolor: Soft washes that darken at their edges, pigment settling in the paper grain.; oil: Dabs of paint that keep the big shapes and melt small detail, on canvas.; cel: Flat bands of light and shadow with bold outlines, like animation.

strength.description: How much of the style: 1 fully painted, 0.5 half over the render.

line_width.description: Line width in pixels at 1280 wide (scaled with the image).

paper.description: How much the paper or canvas texture shows, 0 to 1.

levels.description: Bands of light and shadow in the cel style.

seed.description: Another number, another paper.

then.title: uniform
then.description: The same colour from every direction: a neutral studio or a plain backdrop.

family.description: The same colour from every direction: a neutral studio or a plain backdrop.

color.description: Colour of the surrounding light and background. sRGB hex #rrggbb.

mist.description: Dust or mist in the air, 0 clear to 1 thick fog. 0.1-0.3 indoors shows sunbeams through a window as shafts and softens the far wall; outdoors it hazes the distance.

mist_color.description: Colour of the particles in the air (sRGB hex): white mist, warm dust.

mist_glow.description: How much the air glows looking toward the light, 0 evenly to 0.9 a bright halo with crisp shafts.

then.title: daylight
then.description: Outdoor daylight from dawn to dusk, clear to overcast: a physical sky plus a sun whose direction, colour and softness agree with each other. Light through windows and doors comes from here too.

family.description: Outdoor daylight from dawn to dusk, clear to overcast: a physical sky plus a sun whose direction, colour and softness agree with each other. Light through windows and doors comes from here too.

sun_elevation.description: Sun height above the horizon in degrees. 2-10 early morning or late afternoon (long warm light), 25-45 mid-morning, 60+ midday; 0 to -6 is twilight with no direct sun.

sun_azimuth.description: Direction toward the sun in degrees, counter-clockwise from +X seen from above (0 = +X, 90 = +Y, 180 = -X, 270 = -Y). Shadows point the other way.

cloud_cover.description: 0 clear sky with crisp shadows, 0.5 broken clouds, 1 overcast with no direct sun and soft, even light.

haze.description: Aerosols in the air, 0 crystal clear to 10 very hazy; more haze gives a paler sky.

sun_strength.description: Irradiance of the clear-sky sun in W/m^2 (Blender sun strength); clouds and a low sun reduce it automatically.

sun_angle.description: Apparent diameter of the clear-sky sun in degrees; clouds widen it.

sun_temperature_k.description: Sun colour temperature in kelvin; 0 means automatic, following the elevation (about 2600 K at 5 degrees, 5600 K at 60) and the clouds.

ground_color.description: Colour of the land below the horizon, seen through windows and reflected in glossy things (grass, earth, pavement, snow). sRGB hex #rrggbb.

sky_strength.description: Multiplier for light from the sky (blue fill in shadows).

mist.description: Dust or mist in the air, 0 clear to 1 thick fog. 0.1-0.3 indoors shows sunbeams through a window as shafts and softens the far wall; outdoors it hazes the distance.

mist_color.description: Colour of the particles in the air (sRGB hex): white mist, warm dust.

mist_glow.description: How much the air glows looking toward the light, 0 evenly to 0.9 a bright halo with crisp shafts.
